753:t_168:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You seek a father in me? I welcome that.」

753:t_168:3.en:
$$クェス$$
「You're the same because you force your selfish goodwill on me without caring how I feel!」

753:t_168:4.en:
$$クェス$$
「I'm not lonely! I have the Colonel, $$アムロ$$ and everyone else!」

753:t_168:5.en:
$$クェス$$
「So I'll protect the world everyone lives in! I'll defeat a selfish jerk like you!!」

753:t_169:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ヒイロ$$... Your fighting is over. Eternal peace will soon come.」

753:t_169:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If the universe perishes, fighting will be the least of our concerns... You are certainly right.」

753:t_169:2.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「But I won't accept that... That is no peace...!」

753:t_169:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Then let me ask. What do you mean by peace?」

753:t_169:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Can you answer that, after spending your life fighting as an agent?」

753:t_169:5.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I know someone qualified to answer that.」

753:t_169:6.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「So my fight is to protect that woman.」

753:t_169:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Your eyes hold not a trace of doubt... You... have transcended everything...!」

753:t_169:8.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I've confirmed the target. My final attack target is $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

753:t_169:9.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
($$リリーナ$$... I'm leaving the rest to you.)

753:t_170:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「It's God against the God of Death... That's quite a stylish situation, $$デュオ$$.」

753:t_170:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「It's even funnier that we both gave ourselves those titles.」

753:t_170:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But I am genuine. At the very least, I am a being qualified for that title.」

753:t_170:3.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Then I'll make that same claim myself.」

753:t_170:4.en:
$$デュオ$$
「I'll finish you off to make those words true...! Brace yourself, you imitation god!」

753:t_171:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$トロワ$$... I shall tell you your real name.」

753:t_171:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I know everything about your parents too. You could call me all-knowing and all-powerful.」

753:t_171:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「What are you saying?」

753:t_171:5.en:
$$トロワ$$
「You boast of knowing and being able to do everything, yet all you do is watch the universe collapse.」

753:t_171:6.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Humans who risk their lives fighting, despite their helplessness, are far stronger than you.」

753:t_171:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You are unusually eloquent today.」

753:t_171:8.en:
$$トロワ$$
「It seems I'm happy that defeating you will end the fighting too.」

753:t_171:9.en:
$$トロワ$$
「You will disappear, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. The universe has no need of you.」

753:t_172:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$カトル$$... War has warped your kind heart.」

753:t_172:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But all will be well now. All suffering and sorrow will vanish for a time along with this world.」

753:t_172:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「And a new world will begin...」

753:t_172:4.en:
$$カトル$$
「We won't accept a world like that...」

753:t_172:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You mean to go on living in this world filled with sorrow?」

753:t_172:6.en:
$$カトル$$
「People don't discard their sorrow. They overcome it...! That's how they live...!」

753:t_172:7.en:
$$カトル$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I won't let someone who throws everything away so easily do whatever he wants with people's lives!」

753:t_172:8.en:
$$カトル$$
「I'll fight you to protect all life!!」

753:t_173:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$五飛$$... For someone as pure as you to live, this world is...」

753:t_173:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You would ignore God!?」

753:t_173:3.en:
$$五飛$$
「Even if you're God, you can't lead me astray!」

753:t_173:4.en:
$$五飛$$
「Watch me, $$トレーズ$$! I'll risk my life fighting to protect this world!」

753:t_174:0.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I won't hand this universe's future to a man like you!」

753:t_174:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ゼクス$$... No, $$ミリアルド$$. You have no right to say that after stepping down as a leader of your own accord.」

753:t_174:2.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「That's right...! As you say, I'm a coward who abandoned his responsibility!」

753:t_174:3.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「So I'll become a sacrificial stone for humanity's future!」

753:t_174:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Your resolve is admirable. Your death will be futile, however.」

753:t_174:5.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Even a sacrificial stone can inflict a fatal wound if it hits the right spot!」

753:t_174:6.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「I'll protect the future my friend $$トレーズ$$ entrusted to us!!」

753:t_175:0.en:
$$ノイン$$
「I refuse to acknowledge a hideous being like you as God!」

753:t_175:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You are quite harsh, $$ノイン$$. Are these insults because you cannot admit your own powerlessness?」

753:t_175:2.en:
$$ノイン$$
「I admitted my powerlessness long ago...!」

753:t_175:3.en:
$$ノイン$$
「But I'll teach you, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Humans can still fight for their pride despite that!」

753:t_175:4.en:
$$ノイン$$
「And as long as $$ゼクス$$ is here, I can fight! Wherever $$ゼクス$$ is, that's my battlefield!!」

753:t_176:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You needn't push yourself, $$ヒルデ$$. You no longer need to fight.」

753:t_176:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Welcome the universe's final moments in peace. Leave everything that follows to me.」

753:t_176:4.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Whether you're God or not, you're still my enemy!」

753:t_176:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Then I shall punish you. This is your only chance to reconsider.」

753:t_176:6.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「I'm not afraid...! I have $$デュオ$$... and my comrades!」

753:t_176:7.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「I'll risk my life fighting for what I believe in, because that's how I want to live!」

753:t_177:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You vulgar fool...! You've sunk so low as to call yourself God!」

753:t_177:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Stop putting on a brave front, $$ハマーン$$. Deep down, you must feel awe toward me.」

753:t_177:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Humans overcome that, though someone who declares himself supreme would never understand...!」

753:t_177:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「It cannot be helped. It seems I must punish you to silence you.」

753:t_177:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Then I'll silence you too, by shattering that confidence of yours...!」

753:t_177:5.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「False god $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I won't let your selfishness dictate what happens to the world we live in!」

753:t_177:6.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You will learn the power of humans and their infinite possibilities!」

753:t_178:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I never thought I'd fight a man pretending to be God! I couldn't have imagined it back in $$ネオ・ジオン$$!」

753:t_178:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Are you satisfied now, $$ギュネイ$$? All that remains is for you to meet your end in peace.」

753:t_178:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't joke! I've come this far, so surpassing God doesn't sound bad!」

753:t_178:3.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「The Colonel and $$フロンタル$$ aren't even on my radar anymore! I'm going to defeat a false god possessed by delusions of grandeur!」

753:t_178:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That is a cheap taunt.」

753:t_178:5.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Your smugness ends here, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'll crush you to survive!!」

753:t_179:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$アルト$$... You should know that your wings carry not only your feelings, but someone's sorrow as well.」

753:t_179:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「It's no use trying to shake me with that! Someone like you could never understand the bond between us!」

753:t_179:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You say it is beyond my understanding, even as God?」
